title: Pinned geometric presentation of the two overlap Hom sets
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRingCat a diagram with colimit cocone c, i∈I, Z a scheme and t:Z→Spec(R_i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the shared scheme and localized-open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix j≥i; the hypothesis hstage says every pair of opens of Y_j admits k≥j (the index j itself suffices). Put Y_j=Z×Spec(R_j), X=Z×Spec(c.pt), and g_j:X→Y_j the canonical map. Let U,V be compact opens covering Y_j, A,B perfect objects on their open subschemes [def-pc-perfect-complex], E∈D(X), and φU,φV the given isomorphisms of their limit pullbacks with the exact restrictions of E [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For EVERY k≥j there are exact coherent two-open comparison diagrams d_k [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram], functorial transports κU,κV and siteU,siteV, and θU,θV equal to the composites of these transports with the supplied φU,φV. Their overlap composites ψ_k(false)=γU.symm(A′)≫SP(θU)≫τU(E) and ψ_k(true)=γV.symm(B′)≫SQ(θV)≫τV(E) identify HW_k(SU_k(A′)) and HW_k(SV_k(B′)) with RW(E). For the categories C_k=D((f_kj^{-1}U∩f_kj^{-1}V).toScheme), the two objects F_k(false)=SU_k(A′), F_k(true)=SV_k(B′), the actual functors G_k=HW_k and target objects O(false)=O(true)=RW(E), there is instead a PerfectHomPresentation [lem-pc-perfect-hom-presentation] over the same diagram R and base index j. Thus a finitely presented quasi-compact quasi-separated overlap scheme Y, two perfect objects P(b), stage and apex Hom equivalences preserving identities and composition, and a pinning equation identify the prescribed conjugated limit maps with perfectLimitMap. No morphism lift, eventual equality, or stage transport is asserted. The comparisons have exactly the types and equations of [def-pc-perfect-overlap-hom-continuity-data].

proof.text: Construct W=(U intersection V).toScheme and s=W.ι followed by the stage projection to Spec(R_j). The stage is quasi-separated over an affine scheme, hence is a quasi-separated space. Compact-open intersections are compact; the subtype compact-space criterion makes W compact. Infer local finite presentation by composition of the open immersion and stage projection, quasi-compactness from compact source and affine target, and quasi-separatedness by composition. Define the two objects as derived pullbacks along W→U and W→V, and apply derivedPullback_preserve_perfect to A and B.

Use perfect_overlap_object_realization to obtain the prescribed stage comparison data and categorical equivalences and object isomorphisms for exactly W, s and the two objects just constructed. This supplies the pinned conjugated morphism equation but no geometric finiteness proofs, perfectness proofs or Hom equivalences. Specialize the cached proposition before eliminating its outer Nonempty; keep the dependent pair and project its components without expanding the large stage expressions.

Construct stage and apex Hom equivalences from the fully faithful equivalence functors followed by Iso.homCongr of the supplied object isomorphisms. Functor map_id and map_comp together with cancellation prove stage_id and stage_comp. The realization hom_pin field is exactly the required pin equation for these explicit Hom equivalences. Assemble the geometric finiteness proofs, perfectness proofs and these equivalences into PerfectHomPresentation. No Hom-colimit theorem is used.

proof_origin.note: Completed compact-overlap geometry, perfectness and construction of stage/apex Hom equivalences with identity/composition laws. Pinned geometric comparison construction isolated in lem-pc-perfect-overlap-object-realization. This is a decomposition, not a net hole closure; no unit-level route bypassed.

theorem perfect_overlap_hom_presentation
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapHomPresentationStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage
